items.source:
Create a new Publisher<DataBuffer> based on bytes written to a OutputStream.
  • The parameter outputStreamConsumer is invoked once per subscription of the returned Publisher, when the first item is requested.
  • OutputStream.write() invocations made by outputStreamConsumer are buffered until they exceed the default chunk size of 1024, or when the stream is flushed and then result in a published item if there is demand.
  • If there is no demand, OutputStream.write() will block until there is.
  • If the subscription is cancelled, OutputStream.write() will throw a IOException.
  • The subscription is completed when outputStreamHandler completes.
  • Any exceptions thrown from outputStreamHandler will be dispatched to the Subscriber.
items.translation:
基于写入到 OutputStream 的字节创建一个新的 Publisher<DataBuffer>。
  • 参数 outputStreamConsumer 会在返回的 Publisher 的每个订阅中，当第一个项目被 请求 时被调用一次。
  • outputStreamConsumer 调用的 OutputStream.write() 会被缓冲，直到超过默认的块大小 1024，或者流被 刷新，并且如果有 需求 时，会导致一个 发布 的项目。
  • 如果没有 需求，OutputStream.write() 将阻塞直到有需求。
  • 如果订阅被 取消， OutputStream.write() 将抛出 IOException。
  • 当 outputStreamHandler 完成时，订阅被 完成。
  • outputStreamHandler 抛出的任何异常将被分派给 Subscriber。
